title: The Value of USDA Announcements in the Electronically Traded Corn Futures Market: A Modified Sufficient Test with Risk Adjustments
summary: No future report surprise or realized announcement return may be a pre-entry feature. Daily corn panel alone cannot implement it.
about: Economic value of advance USDA information under risk adjustment.
findings: Authors value advance knowledge of surprises; that does not show a free pre-release signal.
mechanism: Information would be valuable if available before prices adjust; actual public-trader availability remains separate.
build_on: No future report surprise or realized announcement return may be a pre-entry feature. Daily corn panel alone cannot implement it.
code_feasibility: A counterfactual information-value study is codeable; no lawful observable trading signal established in inspected metadata.
